name: polysignal-research
description: Offline prediction-market arithmetic, depth analysis, and evidence verification.

interface.longDescription: Offline prediction-market research tools extracted from PolySignal: explicit fee-scenario arithmetic, order-book depth and weighted midpoint analysis, conditional complete-set payout bounds, and hash-linked evidence integrity checks. Includes three agent skills and dependency-free Python commands. Requires a local host with Python 3.10 or newer and shell/file access. Does not fetch prices, submit orders, authenticate venue receipts, or certify profitability.
defaultPrompt: Model a prediction-market round trip with explicit fee and slippage assumptions.
Analyze my order-book snapshot and show how much depth is actually available.
Verify my evidence journal against its manifest and independently retained root.
